description: OpenAI-API-compatible text embeddings, served by Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B. The expected endpoints are POST /v1/embeddings and GET /v1/models; suppliers MAY expose more of the OpenAI surface but consumers MUST NOT depend on it. Address the model as "pocket_network". Weights are specified: every supplier serves the same model, so vectors are semantically comparable across suppliers (but they are NOT bit-identical).

rpc_types.backend_hint: OpenAI-compatible embeddings server on :8080 (TEI) or :8000 (vLLM --task embed); mount at /
rpc_types.notes: Only POST /v1/embeddings and GET /v1/models are expected.

serving.backend: Any OpenAI-compatible server exposing POST /v1/embeddings and GET /v1/models, serving Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B. The weights ARE specified for this service -- do not substitute another embedding model. The served model MUST answer to the name "pocket_network".
serving.notes: Use a server with dynamic batching so one backend serves many concurrent requests, and expect callers to batch many inputs into a single relay. Serve the specified weights unmodified -- no quantization changes, no pooling changes -- since drifting from them silently degrades every index built on this service. Alias the served model as "pocket_network". It is recommended to isolate the model behind pokt-ml-sidecar and to front it with the HA RelayMiner. See the docs in specs[0] for the full runbook.
